nodes.description: Mapping of reflection balances per address used by the reflection token accounting.
Mapping declared for token balances; unused in the effective accounting path.
ERC20 allowance mapping written by _approve and read by allowance/transferFrom.
Mapping of addresses excluded from transfer fees, set in the constructor.
Blacklist mapping checked in _transfer via require(!bots[from]).
Per-address cooldown mapping declared but not enforced.
Total reflection supply, reduced by fees in _reflectFee.
Payable fee wallet 1; also used as the manualswap/manualsend authorization address.
Uniswap V2 pair address created and stored in openTrading.
Uniswap V2 router instance set in openTrading and used for swaps.
Flag controlling automatic swap-and-send behavior inside _transfer.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by lockTheSwap during swapTokensForEth.
Maximum transaction amount enforced on buys when cooldownEnabled.
Owner address checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Private _transfer: main transfer entry point performing bot checks, cooldown limit, auto-swap and fee routing.
Private swapTokensForEth: approves the router and swaps tokens for ETH via the router.
Private sendETHToFee: splits contract ETH balance into thirds and pushes to fee wallets.
Owner-only openTrading: creates the pair, adds liquidity and enables trading/swap.
Private _tokenTransfer: dispatches to _transferStandard.
Private _transferStandard: computes reflection values and updates balances, team and fee.
Private _takeTeam: credits the team/contract reflection portion.
Private _reflectFee: reduces _rTotal and accrues _tFeeTotal.
External manualswap: uses a require(_msgSender()==_feeAddrWallet1) check to authorize a manual swap.
External manualsend: uses a require(_msgSender()==_feeAddrWallet1) check to authorize a manual ETH send.
Private _getRate: derives the reflection rate from current supply.
Private _getCurrentSupply: returns rSupply/tSupply snapshot values.
Public ERC20 transfer: forwards _msgSender recipient amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom: moves tokens and decrements allowance.
Public ERC20 approve: sets allowance for spender.
Public view returning the owner address.
Owner-only setter toggling cooldownEnabled.
Owner-only function resetting _maxTxAmount to the full total supply.
Constructor: sets fee wallets, mints reflection supply and fee exclusions.
Owner-only renounceOwnership setting _owner to the zero address.
Public balanceOf returning token amount derived from reflections.
msg.sender external caller identity via _msgSender().
block.timestamp used as swap/liquidity deadline.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with amountOutMin 0.
Native ETH transfer _feeAddrWallet1.transfer(amount/3) to an external payable wallet.
External payable call addLiquidityETH on the Uniswap router using the whole contract balance.
External call createPair on the Uniswap factory during openTrading.

edges.reason: Parameter from flows into the private _transfer logic that reads balances and blacklist for it.
Parameter to flows into _transfer and determines the credited recipient.
Parameter amount drives the transfer amount and fee computation in _transfer.
Locally computed contract token balance is used to decide the auto-swap amount in _transfer.
Locally read contract ETH balance gates sendETHToFee inside _transfer.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
path array is passed to the router swap in swapTokensForEth.
amount parameter is split into thirds and pushed to the fee wallets.
recipient parameter forwarded to _transfer by the public transfer function.
amount parameter forwarded to _transfer by the public transfer function.
sender parameter forwarded to _transfer by transferFrom.
recipient parameter forwarded to _transfer by transferFrom.
amount parameter used for the transfer and the allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
tAmount locution drives value computation in _transferStandard.
currentRate is used to compute the team reflection amount in _takeTeam.
Locally captured msgSender becomes the initial owner in the constructor.
msg.sender is used as the sender of the public transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender in transferFrom allowance handling.
manualswap authority relies on comparing _msgSender() with _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authority relies on comparing _msgSender() with _feeAddrWallet1.
msg.sender is read via _msgSender in the constructor to set the owner.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, making execution time-dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading.
Timestamp value is consumed by the external addLiquidityETH call.
Transfer amount is compared against the _maxTxAmount limit.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not in a swap.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap operation.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the contract ETH balance exceeds the threshold.
sendETHToFee pushes native ETH to three external wallets, enabling reentrant receipt of funds.
openTrading performs the external addLiquidityETH call.
openTrading performs the external createPair call on the factory.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth with the contract balance.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
_transfer delegates final accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard.
_transferStandard credits the team portion via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies the reflection fee via _reflectFee.
_takeTeam obtains the current rate from _getRate.
_getRate derives supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
_transfer queries balanceOf(address(this)) for the swap amount.
Public transfer forwards to the private _transfer.
transferFrom forwards to the private _transfer.
_transfer reads the bots blacklist mapping for the sender.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount limit on buy transactions.
_transfer checks swapEnabled before swapping tokens for ETH.
_transfer checks the inSwap guard before swapping tokens for ETH.
_transferStandard writes _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_reflectFee reduces the _rTotal reflection supply.
_takeTeam credits _rOwned of the contract address.
openTrading stores the router instance in uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
The fee wallet state variable receives native ETH during the transfer operation.
liftMaxTx is restricted to the stored _owner via onlyOwner.
setCooldownEnabled is restricted to the stored _owner via onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership is restricted to the stored _owner via onlyOwner.
Constructor assigns the payable fee wallet address.
swapTokensForEth writes the router allowance in the _allowances mapping.
The native ETH transfer to an external wallet can re-enter transfer/_transfer before state is settled.
The router swap call can re-enter token transfer logic before _transfer completes.
